_comment: Template for a new regression run spec. Top-level keys describe the run that gets created; keys under 'filters' select which cases go into it. NOTE that 'tags' means different things in each half: the top-level one labels the run, while filters.tags selects cases. A spec with an empty 'filters' block matches EVERY case in the project — always check the dry-run's case count before --create. Add a 'config_id' when the platform ships several same-named runs distinguished only by Testmo Configuration.
